name: litestream-6d61ef5d-blind30
instr:
# litestream-regen

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits.

This software keeps a live SQLite database continuously copied somewhere else — a cloud bucket, a remote machine, a plain directory — and lets an operator drive and inspect that copying from a terminal. It now gets a long list of things wrong. Nothing about the storage services changed and nothing about the databases changed; the same commands against the same destinations are now handled incorrectly, and in several places an operation that used to succeed is refused outright.

Pointing it at somewhere to copy to, by writing the destination out as an address, goes wrong before a single byte moves. An address for a Google Cloud bucket that names both a bucket and a location inside it is rejected for having no bucket, while the same scheme with no bucket at all is accepted. An address for a publish-and-subscribe broker's key-value store, carrying a machine name and a port, opens a connection aimed at neither, both with and without credentials in it. An Alibaba object-store address whose machine name embeds the region takes that entire name as the bucket, though a plain bucket name with no region still comes out right; and when such a name carries an extra trailing qualifier on its region part before the domain, the region taken from it is wrong, while the ordinary public endpoints still give the right one. An Amazon-style resource name for a named alias endpoint that ends immediately after the alia
